item.title: Aurrigo wins £1.43m government grant to trial autonomous airport vehicles
item.summary: Aurrigo International has been awarded a £1.43m UK government grant to explore how autonomous vehicles can make airports safer. The AIM-listed transport technology company said it would use the funding to deploy its Auto-Shuttle vehicles for routine airfield tasks such as security patrols, perimeter inspections and checking runway and taxiway surfaces for cracks, wear or […] The post Aurrigo wins £1.43m government grant to trial autonomous airport vehicles appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
